Our dedicated team is here to guide you every step of the way, offering expert advice, prompt assistance, and unmatched customer service. Trust ISD to be your reliable partner in the medical field.

Our expertise in procurement, combined with strong partnerships with trusted suppliers, allows us to offer optimized purchasing solutions that meet your specific needs. services-medkit-description: Specialized in the medical sector, our company supports healthcare facilities, clinics, hospitals, laboratories and specialized centers in the full completion of their projects. Our expertise covers the entire process, from the study and design of infrastructures to the supply, installation and commissioning of equipment.
services-formation-description: To ensure optimal and safe use of installed equipment, we provide training for users and technical staff. Our training sessions are tailored to the specific needs of each facility and enable participants to master the operation, basic maintenance and best practices for using the equipment. Our goal is to strengthen team competencies to ensure efficient, sustainable and manufacturer-compliant operation.
services-maintenance-description: We provide preventive and corrective maintenance of equipment to ensure their performance, reliability and longevity. Our technical teams respond quickly to carry out inspections, repairs and necessary maintenance operations, minimizing downtime and ensuring service continuity.
services-consumables: Supply of various consumables and reagents
services-consumables-description: We supply a wide range of consumables and reagents for healthcare facilities, laboratories and analysis centers. As official representatives of Sysmex and Roche Diagnostics, we provide certified products meeting the highest quality standards. We guarantee the reliability of analyses, user safety and business continuity for our clients through regular supply and professional support.
services-equipment-description: We distribute a wide range of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) designed to ensure the safety of professionals in the healthcare, industrial, construction and service sectors. As a distributor of reference brands such as Portwest, Singer Safety and Honeywell, we offer reliable equipment compliant with international standards. Our range includes gloves, masks, protective goggles, helmets, safety shoes, workwear and other solutions tailored to the requirements of each professional environment.
services-inventory-description: Our purchasing center supports all types of clients, whether businesses, public administrations, organizations, healthcare facilities or individuals, in the acquisition of materials, equipment, supplies and consumables of all kinds. Thanks to our extensive network of suppliers and partners, we search for, select and deliver the products best suited to our clients' needs, while ensuring quality, competitiveness and timely delivery.

We are committed to providing high-quality products and services to meet the needs of Congolese healthcare professionals and institutions. Our team of experts does everything possible to ensure our clients have the best solutions for their medical needs, whether they are hospitals, clinics or other healthcare facilities.
isd-epi-description: With our in-house embroidery service, we offer the customization of professional clothing and protective equipment in the colors and image of our clients. Over the years, we have completed numerous projects for leading companies, administrations and organizations, supplying custom workwear, uniforms and PPE combining quality, safety and professionalism. Our expertise allows us to effectively meet the specific needs of each client, regardless of their sector of activity.
isd-achat-description: ISD is a reliable and efficient supplier in the field of procurement, offering a wide range of products and services to meet our clients' needs. We are committed to providing high-quality purchasing solutions at competitive prices, with a focus on customer satisfaction and operational efficiency.

dep-1-description: Our medical department specializes in the supply, installation and maintenance of medical and laboratory equipment, as well as the procurement of consumables and reagents. We support healthcare facilities, laboratories and diagnostic centers by offering reliable, high-performance solutions compliant with international standards. Thanks to our expertise and partnerships with sector leaders such as Sysmex and Roche Diagnostics, we help ensure the quality of analyses, equipment efficiency and continuity of healthcare services.
dep-2-description: Our PPE department is dedicated to the supply of Personal Protective Equipment designed to ensure the safety and protection of professionals across all sectors of activity. We offer a wide range of quality products, including gloves, masks, goggles, helmets, safety shoes and protective clothing. Thanks to our partnerships with reference brands such as Portwest, Singer Safety and Honeywell, we provide solutions compliant with the most demanding international standards.
dep-3-description: Our Purchasing Center department supports companies, public administrations, organizations and individuals in the acquisition of all types of materials, equipment, supplies and consumables. Thanks to an extensive network of international suppliers and partners, we are able to search for, select and provide the products best suited to our clients' needs, while ensuring quality, competitiveness and on-time delivery. Our mission is to simplify procurement processes by offering a reliable, efficient and personalized service.
what-we-are-description: Since 2007, we have been putting our expertise at the service of professionals, institutions and organizations by offering reliable solutions tailored to their needs. Specialized in the medical sector, the supply of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) and purchasing center services, we support our clients with seriousness, professionalism and commitment. Thanks to our experience and our network of trusted partners, we offer quality products and services while ensuring personalized support and lasting satisfaction.
achievements-title-1: Installation of a Neusoft 32B CT Scanner
achievements-description-1: At the end of 2025, our company successfully completed the installation of a Neusoft 32B CT Scanner at Clinique Guénin. This project also included the commissioning of a FUJIFILM DRYPIX EDGE reprographer, a Perlove C-Arm image intensifier and a modern laparoscopy column. This achievement demonstrates our expertise in the supply and installation of high-tech medical equipment for healthcare professionals.
achievements-title-2: Installation of CANON radiology tables; BONE, LUNG and REMOTE-CONTROLLED table
achievements-description-2: During 2025, our company completed the installation of a DMS Imaging bone-lung radiology table at the TotalEnergies EP Congo CMS. This installation reflects our commitment to providing healthcare facilities with high-performance medical imaging equipment suited to diagnostic needs, while ensuring commissioning that meets technical and operational requirements.
achievements-description-3: At the beginning of 2025, our company completed the installation of two Canon Medical brand radiology tables at the Military Hospital of Brazzaville. This project also included the commissioning of a FUJIFILM reprographer designed to optimize the management and printing of medical images. This achievement illustrates our ability to support healthcare facilities in modernizing their medical imaging infrastructure with high-performance and reliable equipment.
achievements-description-4: In 2023, our company successfully completed the full rehabilitation of the CT scanner and MRI rooms at the Brazzaville University Hospital. This large-scale project included the supply and installation of an 80-slice Canon Medical CT scanner and a 1.5 Tesla MRI of the same brand. We also ensured the installation of all equipment and infrastructure necessary for their optimal operation, providing the CHU with modern, high-performance medical imaging solutions compliant with international standards.
